records.plain_description: Fit signal scaling and a waveform/spectrogram model using training recordings only.
records.validity_bounds: Revalidated immutable Prepared configuration. Fixed windows stay within recordings; trailing incomplete samples omitted. Periodic Hann segment-mean-detrended one-sided density PSD with log1p. Recording-balanced training-only channel scaling, constant scales replaced by one. CPU float64 dual 1D waveform/2D spectrogram CNN with frequency-preserving pooling. Seeded time/frequency masks on normalized spectra; class/recording-balanced BCE, Adam and one accumulated update per epoch. All features are materialized in memory; batch size bounds neural forward allocation only. No early stopping, pretrained model, subject-equal weighting or empirical accuracy claim. Trusted model/scaling objects, no portable persistence.

Nonempty subject keys must be disjoint across populations. Validated window/stride/FFT/hop, seed, width, epochs, batch size, learning rate and mask limits. Return detached immutable JSON configuration; no automatic montage or identity discovery.

before.description: Fit a recording-level empirical F1 decision threshold on separate calibration rows.

after.description: Choose a recording-level decision threshold from the separate calibration population. Unmodified Fitted state and revalidated source configuration. Predict mean window probabilities for calibration recordings without fitting model/scaling. Call the existing generic float64 empirical-F1 provider on one score column and int64 binary labels. Inclusive comparison and highest observed threshold among equal F1 values. Return threshold and calibration count while retaining fitted state. This selects a decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy. Caller owns meaningful subject identities; calibration labels must not be used to train the model.

before.description: Fit training-only scaling and the dual waveform/spectrogram model.

after.description: Fit signal scaling and a waveform/spectrogram model using training recordings only. Revalidated immutable Prepared configuration. Fixed windows stay within recordings; trailing incomplete samples omitted. Periodic Hann segment-mean-detrended one-sided density PSD with log1p. Recording-balanced training-only channel scaling, constant scales replaced by one. CPU float64 dual 1D waveform/2D spectrogram CNN with frequency-preserving pooling. Seeded time/frequency masks on normalized spectra; class/recording-balanced BCE, Adam and one accumulated update per epoch. All features are materialized in memory; batch size bounds neural forward allocation only. No early stopping, pretrained model, subject-equal weighting or empirical accuracy claim. Trusted model/scaling objects, no portable persistence.
